protocol.presentation: First requestAnimationFrame after unique viewport paint. Submission-to-presentation upper-bound proxy, not a physical display photon measurement.
protocol.frameMs: Intervals between changed viewport images; excludes overlay-only/UI paints. RAF FPS is separately reported.
protocol.cpu: Inclusive wasm spans; nested intervals must not be added. JS/wasm boundary overhead is not separately measurable and is reported null.
protocol.cameraLatency: Browser capture-phase event to first changed viewport paint after it (next RAF); intermediate coalesced events may not have their own frame.
protocol.placementLatency: Capture-phase left mousedown to first painted revision >= successful edit revision (next RAF). Rejections/no-ops separately counted.
protocol.analysis: scripts/lib/camera-metrics.mjs; GPU wait/readback is wall time, not CPU time. No changed-image metrics are attributed to overlay-only phases.
protocol.causalCameraLatency: inputToCausalFrameMs: injection event timestamp to first painted image whose render began after the associated navigation event; includes dispatch backlog and excludes already-in-flight images. Intermediate coalesced camera states need not appear separately.
